Q: Don't Summarize Option Problem In Power BI A:

There is chance to duplicating the values so you might get more value than the present value. So have to create new table using below DAX then apply to you visual.

DISTINCT(SUMMARIZE(ResellerSales_USD  
      , DateTime[CalendarYear]  
      , "Sales Amount (USD)", SUM(ResellerSales_USD[SalesAmount_USD])  
      )

Q: Get-winEvent to XML, now how to get the values out A:

A quick example of xml named eventdata fields. #text has to be quoted to not be treated as a comment.

$xml = [xml](get-winevent system -MaxEvents 1).toxml()


$xml.event.eventdata.data

Name           #text
----           -----
HiveNameLength 175
HiveName       \??\C:\ProgramData\Packages\Microsoft.WindowsTerminalPreview_8wekyb3d8bbwe\S-1-5-21-1686402789-159416...
KeysUpdated    1
DirtyPages     1


$xml.event.eventdata.data | ? name -eq HiveNameLength | % '#text'

175

Or convert the eventdata into a hashtable:

$xml.event.eventdata.data | % { $hash = @{} } { $hash[$_.name] = $_.'#text' }
$hash['hivenamelength']

175

Q: What causes git-apply "corrupt patch?" A:

In case it helps anyone, in my case the "corrupt patch" was caused by an otherwise-good setting in my text editor (VS Code) that removes trailing whitespace on save. But in a diff file, you need a space character in the first column for every context line. So an empty context line is just a single space... a trailing space. When I saved the patch file, that space got removed, which was enough to create a "corrupt patch".

Q: Find path by sea from coastal point A to coastal point B A:

There's now another option beyond rolling your own raster grid — auto-sea-way generates a routing graph from OSM land polygons using H3 hexagons (41M+ cells, adaptive resolution). Written in Rust, routing is sub-millisecond for short routes and under 2s even for transatlantic crossings. Self-hosted via Docker:

$ docker run -e ASW_API_KEY=test -p 3000:3000 ghcr.io/auto-sea-way/asw:0.3.1-full
# wait ~90s for graph load, then:
$ curl -H 'X-Api-Key: test' 'http://localhost:3000/route?from=51.95,-1.86&to=40.64,-74.00'

Routes stay off land, keep distance from coast naturally (coarser cells offshore), and passages like Suez/Panama work at high resolution. Returns a GeoJSON LineString with 5-20 waypoints — ready for Google Maps/Leaflet.

Disclosure: I'm the author of auto-sea-way.
